cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

mechanism: A supervises a family photograph by adding blink control, rehearsal and then oversight of rehearsal time.
confusable: D190 processes requests; D192 adds successive control structures in response to problems.
comparison: Involuntary blinks and dwindling family time differ from serving-risk authorization.
seedUse: Keep photo/time pressure; make A correct actual proposed solutions rather than declare professionalism.
